risk_register.description: Delay in receiving production API credentials from the third‑party payment vendor, blocking backend integration.
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Escalate vendor credential delay to vendor account manager and request expedited delivery; consider alternative payment gateway if delay persists.

risk_register.description: Chosen UI component library may not fully meet accessibility requirements, potentially requiring a mid‑project replacement.
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Review accessibility compliance of UI library; evaluate alternative UI libraries; plan for potential replacement early.

risk_register.description: Staging environment instability blocking QA regression testing for three consecutive days.
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: File infrastructure ticket for staging instability; set up monitoring; coordinate with ops to resolve quickly.

risk_register.description: Potential release date slip of one to two weeks if vendor credential delay is not resolved within five business days.
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Escalate vendor delay; track progress; adjust release plan; communicate delay to stakeholders.
